subject: Customer request: unwind bridge credit + staged downgrade protections
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearbridge.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Notice of anticipated ramp down & request for bridge credit

Hi Tessa —

Quick heads-up from ClearBridge: our usage forecast for Q1 shows a planned reduction starting Jan 1. We expect a staged ramp down over three months as several pilots wrap and procurement for remaining scopes closes later.

Given the timing, procurement asked whether Redwood will consider an early-termination / downsell credit (bridge credit) that smooths the financial impact while we finalize remaining integrations. They also want explicit opt-out language in the ramp schedule so we can decouple a pilot without triggering penalties.

Can you confirm what policies/options are available? If there are standard templates (credit buckets or staged grace windows) we can share with our procurement/legal. Happy to set a 30-min call if that helps.

Attachments: requested_unwind_notice.pdf (short notice from procurement)

Thanks —
Maria
Maria Gomez
Head of Contracting, ClearBridge Health
mar ia.gomez@clearbridge.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice of anticipated ramp down & request for bridge credit

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the note and the PDF. We’re sympathetic to smoothing the transition. High level options we can propose quickly:

- Short bridge credit bucket: one-time credit equal to X% of remaining committed spend (applied as account credit over 90 days).
- Staged downgrade schedule: tiered baseline reductions with clear opt-out windows (30/60/90 days) to avoid immediate penalties.
- Pilot carve-outs: allow specific pilot projects to opt out of the commitment with a smaller unwind fee.

Before I put something formal in writing, I need approvals from my manager and Rev Ops on the credit sizing and from Rishi for any pricing exceptions. Laura / Rishi — can you weigh in on whether we have flexibility to grant a 20–30% bridge credit bucket for a 3-month unwind, or prefer a fixed-dollar approach? Also tagging legal for a quick redline once we agree high-level.

If it helps the procurement team, I can draft a one-page mutual action plan with the staged schedule and opt-out language for legal review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearbridge.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice of anticipated ramp down & request for bridge credit

Tessa / Maria —

I reviewed the procurement note. Approve in principle, with the following constraints:

1) Bridge credit capped at the lesser of 25% of remaining committed monthly average or three months of committed spend, whichever is smaller.
2) Staged downgrade schedule needs an explicit 30-day notice per step and a final 90-day full unwind window to allow for capacity reallocation.
3) Any opt-out language cannot waive outstanding charges for usage already processed; it only impacts future committed minimums.

Please loop Legal to draft the specific contract language. Rishi — we will need a formal pricing exception ticket and an exec-signed memo for records (finance will insist). Tessa, please prepare the short MAP and include the proposed credit calculation; I’ll sign it if the numbers align.

Attachment: proposed_bridge_credit_terms.xlsx (spreadsheet with example calc)

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearbridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Notice of anticipated ramp down & request for bridge credit

Thanks team —

I approve the approach Laura outlined with one additional operational condition: the credit will be issued as account credit applied over the subsequent billing cycle only after we receive the signed MAP and a single-page approval memo from me and Finance. We also require a signed amendment (DocuSign) that codifies the staged downgrade schedule and the opt-out windows.

Tessa — please:
- Finalize the one-page MAP with the spreadsheet calc and upload to HubSpot (link below).
- Send the amendment to ClearBridge for signature via DocuSign.
- Open a pricing-exception ticket including the approval memo; attach it to the deal record.

I’ve attached the signed approval memo for your records (approval_memo_signed.pdf). Once DocuSign returns with signatures, Finance will post the credit to their account.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rc/1234-approval-bridge-credit
